item.text: {"category_edits":[{"category":"learning_objective","rationale":"Add an unweighted pairwise term with coefficient 0.1 to the existing weighted loss, using the same valid positive/negative pairs. This may improve candidate ordering while preserving sampling, architecture, inference, and training settings.","edits":[{"find":"    pairwise_loss = torch.nn.functional.softplus(valid_neg - valid_pos)\n    return (weights * pairwise_loss).sum()","replace":"    pairwise_loss = torch.nn.functional.softplus(valid_neg - valid_pos)\n    return (weights * pairwise_loss).sum() + 0.1 * pairwise_loss.mean()"}]}],"change_summary":"Retain the current loss and add 0.1 times mean pairwise softplus over existing valid pairs.
